name: lhlogging-dashboard
description: Faceplate conformance tooling. The app itself is Python; this only provides `npm run check`. There are no dependencies to install -- bin/faceplate.mjs is vendored from faceplate v2.0.0 (sha256 d66666c10cd2ba006479043e28876ef34bae1f19610073b1189c424df9c863ab) because the upstream repo is private and CI has no credentials for it. It reads its values from the checksummed dist/tokens.json.
